title: Enhancing Sustainability Through Slum Settlement Upgrading. Case Study Outdoor Space of Kampung Mojo, Surakarta
content: The slum upgrading of Kampung Mojo is one collaborative program aimed at improving the quality of slum settlement by supporting basic infrastructure and providing housing. This study focuses on the sustainability of settlement based on three pillars of sustainability: social, economic, and environment by exploring the usage of outdoor space following the upgrading process. The objective is to gather insights that cater to the community's needs and foster the realization of sustainable settlement. The method used in this study is qualitative descriptive with data collection techniques through observation and interviews. The findings of this study underscore a diverse array of activities in outdoor spaces that yield positive implications for raising the sense of communities, creating new economic opportunities, and productive land usage to contribute in achieving Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs).
